# guix_secrets (Resource)

A logical collection of private files. Attach it to guix_blueprint.secrets for installation by image and host consumers through the bundled guix secrets extension. This descriptor itself performs no I/O and has no SOPS or age dependency. Terraform state contains the file contents. Removing files or destroying this descriptor does not delete files from running hosts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "guix_secrets" "server" {
  files = {
    "/etc/example/private-key" = {
      content = var.private_key
      mode    = "0600"
    }
  }
}

variable "private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Pass secrets = guix_secrets.server to guix_blueprint. Image consumers install
# these files in a private copy after building; hosts install them before any
# required Guix deployment. The files never enter the Guix store.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `files` (Attributes Map) Files keyed by absolute destination path. Consuming images and hosts install these files outside /gnu/store with root ownership. Contents are sensitive and remain outside the Guix source bundle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the secret file collection.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `content` (String, Sensitive) File contents, retained as sensitive Terraform state.

Optional:

- `mode` (String) Installed Unix file mode; defaults to 0600.
